node.title: Re: Tool for pulling up documentation for individual functions in a module?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
perldoc -f works for built-in Perl functions. I'm wondering if there is a tool out there for pulling up a pod entry for a function in my own module. Thanks.

[doc://perlfunc] is treated specially by the tools, it's not a general-purpose solution at work there. Although there is [doc://Pod::Select], that's deprecated in the core now, and it seems to me that [dist://Pod-Simple] doesn't have a direct replacement. A couple of possible solutions are: I haven't tried them, but on CPAN there's [mod://Pod::Simple::Select] and [mod://Pod::Section] (sadly, both modules don't appear to have a decent test suite). Lower-level would be to have a look at how the select method in [doc://Pod::Usage] works (that module could also be used in a hacky solution by redirecting its output), or if you want to write something custom, I've used [doc://Pod::Simple::SimpleTree] ([https://github.com/haukex/Algorithm-Odometer-Tiny/blob/e380f57d17/t/Algorithm_Odometer_Tiny_Testlib.pm#L53|example]).
